full_judgment: 2. FIR was lodged on 12-9-2004 of an occurrence dated 11-9-2004, by the informant opposite party, implicating the accused petitioners in a case under sections 143/341/302/379/34 of the Penal Code, alleging, that, accused petitioners in collusion with each other and on the conspiracy of the accused No.1, on 11-9-2004 at about 8-15 PM, while the full brother of the informant, deceased, Ayub Khan, with his cousin's husband, Babul was returning home, was done to death by the accused petitioners. This case, after investigation, was sent for trial and there-after, as per order of the Government, the trial was shifted to the Court of Druta Bichar Tribunal. When the trial was continued, the accused petitioners filed application for returning the case to the original Court, as per their contention, the time, as specified under section 10(4) of Druta Bichar Tribunal Ain, 2002, shortly, the Ain, i.e. 135 working days, has been over/elapsed. Learned Judge by the impugned order dated 14-6-2006 rejected the prayer although holding that 135 working days has elapsed 'yesterday'.
